meta.what: PR-C1 baseline (docs/specs/m2-player-reactions.md): one digest per play from packages/app/test/pr-digest.ts, captured before the player-reactions build. Recaptured only by a person who has checked a change was intended.
meta.treeNote: Captured from the working tree, not from the commit: tracked files had uncommitted changes from other sessions. The sha256 values below say what the drawing code and data were.
meta.digest: sha256 of JSON.stringify({ marks: [side:slot, keys] sorted by side:slot, ball, scale: ballScale, paths, liveEnd, total }), first 16 hex characters
meta.built: timeline({ event, runoffSeconds: 0, human: null, ownStart: 'lined' }, templates, { presetPackage, endZoneYards: 10, numbers: {}, pxPerYard: 9.26, markPx: 14, motion })

inputs.about: A hash of what each source was drawn from (its play events and its rating table), not of a drawing. If one differs, the sim or a fixture changed and the digests below can't judge the drawing.

noRatings.about: Every play drawn with no ctx.ratings. PR1 and PR-C1: every one of these stays equal.

withRatings.about: RECORD OF THE BEHAVIOR BEFORE THE BUILD. Every play drawn with the ratings the app passes (speed, agility, awareness per player id, as app.ts motionRatings(); the fixtures use the fixed table prFixtureRatings()). PR2 and PR-C1 hold only the kick plays equal (kickoff, onsideKick, punt, fieldGoal, extraPoint). The scrimmage plays are meant to change: they are kept for before and after counts, not asserted.
